description: Get aggregated build analytics for the workspace: totals, success rate, average/median build time, per-app breakdown, platform and worker breakdowns, and store-submission counts over a date range.

app_id.description: Filter to a single release app ID (optional)

from.description: Start of range as ISO date/time (optional; defaults to 30 days ago)

to.description: End of range as ISO date/time (optional; defaults to now)

name: ubriot_build_analytics
